deployments_detail.use: Instinct MI300/MI325 AI accelerators (GPUs for AI training/inference); Data Center segment record $16.6B FY25 (+32% YoY)

GitHub Copilot rolled out to 20,000+ hardware, firmware and software engineers on GitHub Enterprise as an AI pair-programmer; AMD reports 50%+ acceptance of AI-generated code (vs ~30% with prior completion tools) and feature cycles compressed from weeks to days. [GitHub Copilot (Microsoft)]
deployments_detail.value: 50%+ code-suggestion acceptance; feature cycles cut from weeks to days; 20,000+ engineers

deployments_detail.use: AMD is training an in-house coding assistant on proprietary AMD codebases and use cases (graphics software, low-level firmware) to cover the full SDLC (code review, debugging, optimization, testing) where public-data copilots fall short. [in-house (AMD)]
deployments_detail.value: targeting 25% developer productivity boost once all AI tools integrated

deployments_detail.use: GAIA: AMD's open-source framework/SDK for building and running local LLM agents on Ryzen AI PCs, executing models on the integrated NPU/iGPU without cloud dependency. [AMD (Ryzen AI NPU; open-source)]
AMD's marketing organization deploys large language models internally for copywriting, copyediting, generating video summaries, and developing training/enablement materials. [LLMs (unspecified)]
Internal use of AI to accelerate silicon/chip design: CEO Lisa Su states AMD is using AI to design chips faster and more reliably, with the goal of increasing the number of products shipped per year.

Via its Silo AI acquisition, AMD develops and releases open multilingual foundation models (Poro and Viking families covering European/Nordic languages) trained on AMD Instinct GPUs, published openly on Hugging Face. [Silo AI / LumiOpen (AMD); trained on AMD Instinct MI250]

AMD Chat: a GPU-accelerated, local/offline AI assistant built into AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition (RX 9070 series) that answers questions about the user's AMD hardware, toggles Adrenalin features, and does text/image generation on-device. [AMD (local LLM on Adrenalin, RDNA GPU-accelerated)]

GitHub Advanced Security with Copilot Autofix used to auto-triage 1M+ nightly build/simulation results and automatically patch legacy-code vulnerabilities, reducing morning manual triage to near zero. [GitHub Advanced Security / Copilot Autofix (Microsoft)]
deployments_detail.value: 70% of vulnerability classes resolved automatically; 1M+ nightly simulations auto-triaged
